maddeler.e:
ننضوي (form VII)
# نَنْضَوِي (nanḍawī) /nan.dˤa.wiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْضَوَى (inḍawā)
# نَنْضَوِيَ (nanḍawiya) /nan.dˤa.wi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْضَوَى (inḍawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
